source_text: During May–September 2011, mosquito larvae were collected in irrigated rice fields surrounding Tiassalé, southern Côte d’Ivoire (5°52′47′′N; 4°49′48′′W) and reared to adults... A total of 1,571 adult female An. gambiae s.l. mosquitoes... a subsample of 500 mosquitoes were all found to be the M molecular form of An. gambiae s.s.
